main_measure.name: OLS slope of excess 2-bar return on forecast (Sunday falls)
main_measure.threshold: slope t >= 2 with positive forecast-weighted mean excess 2-bar return confirms; slope t <= -2 rejects; at least 200 cases

decided_by: The slope's t is between -2 and 2.
reading: Sunday is the bar whose UTC start timestamp is a Sunday; the coin's mean 2-bar return is pooled over all its windows on each window's grid of rows 0, 2, 4, ...; the regression is ordinary least squares with an intercept on all pooled cases.
